subject: Buddy versus every catalogued model/provider
scope: Run every registered benchmark suite that is applicable to each catalogued model/provider and record comparable evidence by capability.
entity_rule: A catalogued model/provider is not treated as evaluated until benchmark evidence exists for the applicable suites. Company/provider metadata and model results remain separate.
comparison_rule: Compare Buddy and each reference model only under the same task fixture, rubric, applicable safety constraints, and declared execution conditions. Do not infer missing results.
gap_rule: Every failed, blocked, stale, or missing applicable benchmark becomes a visible gap or verification state; only passing evidence can close a gap.
native_mastery_rule: External-model-assisted execution may be shown as assisted evidence but cannot establish native Buddy mastery.
pages_rule: Generate a public-safe prospectus record for each model/provider and a Buddy aggregate comparison. Never expose secrets, private prompts/data, restricted endpoints, or credentials.
history: Preserve prior verified snapshots so users can see progress over time.
scale_rule: Use batching/parallel execution for independent model-suite cases inside the single benchmark workflow; preserve dependency ordering for repairs and retests.
cost_rule: Paid/private models may be catalogued publicly but remain unverified/blocked unless an explicitly approved evaluation adapter is available.
